package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticTemplateCode = "teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1"
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode   = "teacher.onboarding-semantic.v1"

	TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariablesMaximumBytes = 64 << 10
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticTurnMaximumRunes      = 4000
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticContextMaximumRunes   = 4000
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticPromptMaximumRunes    = 2000
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticResponseMaximumRunes  = 12000
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticCodeMaximumRunes      = 64
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticTextMaximumRunes      = 1000
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticStackMaximumItems     = 16
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticWeeklyMinutesMaximum  = 10080
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidateMaximum      = 9
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestionMaximum       = 3
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertaintyMaximum    = 9
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestionMaximumRunes  = 600
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticDetailMaximumRunes    = 400
	TeacherOnboardingSemanticConfidenceMaximum     = 10000
)

var (
	ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic            = errors.New("invalid teacher onboarding semantic execution")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticCapabilityDisabled = errors.New("teacher onboarding semantic capability disabled")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnavailable        = errors.New("teacher onboarding semantic unavailable")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnknown            = errors.New("teacher onboarding semantic execution unknown")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticConflict           = errors.New("teacher onboarding semantic execution conflict")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticPending            = errors.New("teacher onboarding semantic execution pending")
	ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticProviderOutput     = errors.New("invalid teacher onboarding semantic provider output")
)

// TeacherOnboardingSemanticConflictError preserves the safe retry signal from
// AI Prompt without exposing its response body. Pending and conflict are
// distinct domain outcomes; RetryAfter is advisory and never a metric label.
type TeacherOnboardingSemanticConflictError struct {
	Pending    bool
	RetryAfter int
}

func (err *TeacherOnboardingSemanticConflictError) Error() string {
	if err == nil {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticConflict.Error()
	}
	if err.Pending {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticPending.Error()
	}
	return ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticConflict.Error()
}

func (err *TeacherOnboardingSemanticConflictError) Unwrap() error {
	if err != nil && err.Pending {
		return ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticPending
	}
	return ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticConflict
}

// TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest is transient and contains only bounded
// snapshots. AIExecutionID is the caller-issued causal/idempotency UUID; the
// opaque AI Prompt execution_id is intentionally not represented here.
type TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest struct {
	AIExecutionID string
	LanguageCode  string
	Variables     TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables struct {
	StudentTurn     TeacherOnboardingSemanticStudentTurn     `json:"student_turn"`
	OnboardingState TeacherOnboardingSemanticOnboardingState `json:"onboarding_state"`
	DialogContext   TeacherOnboardingSemanticDialogContext   `json:"dialog_context"`
	SemanticStage   TeacherOnboardingSemanticStage           `json:"semantic_stage"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticStudentTurn struct {
	Text string `json:"text"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticOnboardingState struct {
	State             string                                  `json:"state"`
	DraftVersion      int64                                   `json:"draft_version"`
	ProfileVersion    int64                                   `json:"profile_version"`
	AcceptedSlots     []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot `json:"accepted_slots"`
	ActiveInteraction TeacherOnboardingSemanticInteraction    `json:"active_interaction"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticInteraction struct {
	Kind          string   `json:"kind"`
	UIKind        string   `json:"ui_kind"`
	PromptText    string   `json:"prompt_text"`
	ExpectedSlots []string `json:"expected_slots"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticDialogContext struct {
	Summary             string `json:"summary"`
	ActiveTeacherPrompt string `json:"active_teacher_prompt"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticStage struct {
	Kind                string                                  `json:"kind"`
	Reason              string                                  `json:"reason"`
	PriorCandidateSlots []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot `json:"prior_candidate_slots"`
}

// TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot uses the fixed branch representation
// required by AI Prompt. Origin is input-only evidence and is not present in
// the model response candidate type.
type TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot struct {
	Slot                  TeacherOnboardingSlotCode `json:"slot"`
	CodeValue             string                    `json:"code_value"`
	TextValue             string                    `json:"text_value"`
	StringListValue       []string                  `json:"string_list_value"`
	IntegerValue          int                       `json:"integer_value"`
	ConfidenceBasisPoints int                       `json:"confidence_basis_points"`
	Origin                string                    `json:"origin"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult struct {
	Schema         string                                 `json:"schema"`
	Response       string                                 `json:"response"`
	SlotCandidates []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate   `json:"slot_candidates"`
	Questions      []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion    `json:"questions"`
	Uncertainties  []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty `json:"uncertainties"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate struct {
	Slot                  TeacherOnboardingSlotCode `json:"slot"`
	CodeValue             string                    `json:"code_value"`
	TextValue             string                    `json:"text_value"`
	StringListValue       []string                  `json:"string_list_value"`
	IntegerValue          int                       `json:"integer_value"`
	ConfidenceBasisPoints int                       `json:"confidence_basis_points"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion struct {
	Slot     TeacherOnboardingSlotCode `json:"slot"`
	Question string                    `json:"question"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty struct {
	Slot   TeacherOnboardingSlotCode `json:"slot"`
	Reason string                    `json:"reason"`
	Detail string                    `json:"detail"`
}

// TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution is the safe adapter result. Provider
// metadata and AI Prompt's opaque execution_id are deliberately discarded.
type TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution struct {
	Result          TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult
	LanguageCode    string
	TemplateVersion int
	Cached          bool
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest(input TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) (TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest, error) {
	input.AIExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AIExecutionID)
	input.LanguageCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.LanguageCode))
	if parsed, err := uuid.Parse(input.AIExecutionID); err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	} else {
		input.AIExecutionID = parsed.String()
	}
	if input.LanguageCode != "ru" && input.LanguageCode != "en" {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	variables, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables(input.Variables)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest{}, err
	}
	input.Variables = variables
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables(input TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables) (TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables, error) {
	input.DialogContext.Summary = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogContext.Summary)
	input.DialogContext.ActiveTeacherPrompt = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogContext.ActiveTeacherPrompt)
	if !validSemanticText(input.StudentTurn.Text, TeacherOnboardingSemanticTurnMaximumRunes) ||
		input.OnboardingState.State != "draft" || input.OnboardingState.DraftVersion < 0 || input.OnboardingState.ProfileVersion < 0 ||
		input.OnboardingState.AcceptedSlots == nil || len(input.OnboardingState.AcceptedSlots) > len(teacherOnboardingSlotOrder()) ||
		input.OnboardingState.ActiveInteraction.ExpectedSlots == nil ||
		!validSemanticTextOrEmpty(input.DialogContext.Summary, TeacherOnboardingSemanticContextMaximumRunes) ||
		!validSemanticTextOrEmpty(input.DialogContext.ActiveTeacherPrompt, TeacherOnboardingSemanticPromptMaximumRunes) ||
		input.SemanticStage.PriorCandidateSlots == nil || len(input.SemanticStage.PriorCandidateSlots) > TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidateMaximum {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	input.StudentTurn.Text = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentTurn.Text)
	if err := normalizeSemanticInteraction(&input.OnboardingState.ActiveInteraction); err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{}, err
	}
	var err error
	input.OnboardingState.AcceptedSlots, err = normalizeSemanticSnapshots(input.OnboardingState.AcceptedSlots, true)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{}, err
	}
	input.SemanticStage.PriorCandidateSlots, err = normalizeSemanticSnapshots(input.SemanticStage.PriorCandidateSlots, false)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{}, err
	}
	if err := normalizeSemanticStage(&input.SemanticStage); err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables{}, err
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(input TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult) (TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.Response = strings.TrimSpace(input.Response)
	if input.Schema != TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode || !validSemanticText(input.Response, TeacherOnboardingSemanticResponseMaximumRunes) ||
		input.SlotCandidates == nil || input.Questions == nil || input.Uncertainties == nil ||
		len(input.SlotCandidates) > TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidateMaximum ||
		len(input.Questions) > TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestionMaximum ||
		len(input.Uncertainties) > TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertaintyMaximum {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	if err := normalizeSemanticCandidates(input.SlotCandidates); err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, err
	}
	if err := normalizeSemanticQuestions(input.Questions); err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, err
	}
	if err := normalizeSemanticUncertainties(input.Uncertainties); err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, err
	}
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeSemanticInteraction(input *TeacherOnboardingSemanticInteraction) error {
	if input != nil {
		input.PromptText = strings.TrimSpace(input.PromptText)
	}
	if input == nil || (input.Kind != "none" && input.Kind != "question" && input.Kind != "confirmation") ||
		(input.UIKind != "none" && input.UIKind != "choice" && input.UIKind != "text" && input.UIKind != "confirmation") ||
		input.ExpectedSlots == nil || len(input.ExpectedSlots) > len(teacherOnboardingSlotOrder()) ||
		!validSemanticTextOrEmpty(input.PromptText, TeacherOnboardingSemanticPromptMaximumRunes) {
		return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	if input.Kind == "none" {
		if input.UIKind != "none" || input.PromptText != "" || len(input.ExpectedSlots) != 0 {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		return nil
	}
	if input.UIKind == "none" || !validSemanticText(input.PromptText, TeacherOnboardingSemanticPromptMaximumRunes) || len(input.ExpectedSlots) == 0 {
		return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	seen := make(map[TeacherOnboardingSlotCode]struct{}, len(input.ExpectedSlots))
	for index := range input.ExpectedSlots {
		input.ExpectedSlots[index] = strings.TrimSpace(input.ExpectedSlots[index])
		slot := TeacherOnboardingSlotCode(input.ExpectedSlots[index])
		if !validTeacherOnboardingSlot(slot) {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		if _, exists := seen[slot]; exists {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		seen[slot] = struct{}{}
	}
	sort.Slice(input.ExpectedSlots, func(left, right int) bool {
		return semanticSlotIndex(TeacherOnboardingSlotCode(input.ExpectedSlots[left])) < semanticSlotIndex(TeacherOnboardingSlotCode(input.ExpectedSlots[right]))
	})
	return nil
}

func normalizeSemanticStage(input *TeacherOnboardingSemanticStage) error {
	if input == nil {
		return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	input.Kind = strings.TrimSpace(input.Kind)
	input.Reason = strings.TrimSpace(input.Reason)
	switch input.Kind {
	case "default":
		if input.Reason != "" || len(input.PriorCandidateSlots) != 0 {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
	case "fallback_after_conflict", "fallback_after_ambiguity", "fallback_after_rejection", "fallback_after_correction":
		if (input.Reason != "conflict" && input.Reason != "ambiguity" && input.Reason != "rejection" && input.Reason != "correction") || len(input.PriorCandidateSlots) == 0 {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
	default:
		return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeSemanticSnapshots(values []TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot, requireOrigin bool) ([]TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot, error) {
	result := make([]TeacherOnboardingSemanticSlotSnapshot, len(values))
	copy(result, values)
	seen := make(map[TeacherOnboardingSlotCode]struct{}, len(result))
	for index := range result {
		value := &result[index]
		value.CodeValue = strings.TrimSpace(value.CodeValue)
		value.TextValue = strings.TrimSpace(value.TextValue)
		if value.StringListValue == nil {
			return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		stringList := make([]string, len(value.StringListValue))
		copy(stringList, value.StringListValue)
		value.StringListValue = stringList
		if !validTeacherOnboardingSlot(value.Slot) || value.ConfidenceBasisPoints < 0 || value.ConfidenceBasisPoints > TeacherOnboardingSemanticConfidenceMaximum ||
			(requireOrigin && value.Origin != "explicit_ui" && value.Origin != "explicit_text") || (!requireOrigin && value.Origin != "") {
			return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value.Slot]; exists {
			return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		seen[value.Slot] = struct{}{}
		switch value.Slot {
		case TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage, TeacherOnboardingSlotPace:
			if !validSemanticText(value.CodeValue, TeacherOnboardingSemanticCodeMaximumRunes) || value.TextValue != "" || len(value.StringListValue) != 0 || value.IntegerValue != 0 {
				return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
		case TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText:
			if value.CodeValue != "" || !validSemanticText(value.TextValue, TeacherOnboardingSemanticTextMaximumRunes) || len(value.StringListValue) != 0 || value.IntegerValue != 0 {
				return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
		case TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks, TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
			if value.CodeValue != "" || value.TextValue != "" || value.IntegerValue != 0 || len(value.StringListValue) == 0 || len(value.StringListValue) > TeacherOnboardingSemanticStackMaximumItems {
				return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
			stackSeen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(value.StringListValue))
			for item := range value.StringListValue {
				value.StringListValue[item] = strings.TrimSpace(value.StringListValue[item])
				if !validSemanticText(value.StringListValue[item], TeacherOnboardingSemanticCodeMaximumRunes) {
					return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
				}
				if _, exists := stackSeen[value.StringListValue[item]]; exists {
					return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
				}
				stackSeen[value.StringListValue[item]] = struct{}{}
			}
			sort.Strings(value.StringListValue)
		case TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
			if value.CodeValue != "" || value.TextValue != "" || len(value.StringListValue) != 0 || value.IntegerValue < 1 || value.IntegerValue > TeacherOnboardingSemanticWeeklyMinutesMaximum {
				return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		return semanticSlotIndex(result[left].Slot) < semanticSlotIndex(result[right].Slot)
	})
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeSemanticCandidates(values []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate) error {
	seen := make(map[TeacherOnboardingSlotCode]struct{}, len(values))
	for index := range values {
		value := &values[index]
		value.CodeValue = strings.TrimSpace(value.CodeValue)
		value.TextValue = strings.TrimSpace(value.TextValue)
		if value.StringListValue == nil || !validTeacherOnboardingSlot(value.Slot) || value.ConfidenceBasisPoints < 0 || value.ConfidenceBasisPoints > TeacherOnboardingSemanticConfidenceMaximum {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value.Slot]; exists {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		seen[value.Slot] = struct{}{}
		switch value.Slot {
		case TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage, TeacherOnboardingSlotPace:
			if !validSemanticText(value.CodeValue, TeacherOnboardingSemanticCodeMaximumRunes) || value.TextValue != "" || len(value.StringListValue) != 0 || value.IntegerValue != 0 {
				return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
		case TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText:
			if value.CodeValue != "" || !validSemanticText(value.TextValue, TeacherOnboardingSemanticTextMaximumRunes) || len(value.StringListValue) != 0 || value.IntegerValue != 0 {
				return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
		case TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks, TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
			if value.CodeValue != "" || value.TextValue != "" || value.IntegerValue != 0 || len(value.StringListValue) == 0 || len(value.StringListValue) > TeacherOnboardingSemanticStackMaximumItems {
				return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
			stackSeen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(value.StringListValue))
			for item := range value.StringListValue {
				value.StringListValue[item] = strings.TrimSpace(value.StringListValue[item])
				if !validSemanticText(value.StringListValue[item], TeacherOnboardingSemanticCodeMaximumRunes) {
					return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
				}
				if _, exists := stackSeen[value.StringListValue[item]]; exists {
					return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
				}
				stackSeen[value.StringListValue[item]] = struct{}{}
			}
		case TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
			if value.CodeValue != "" || value.TextValue != "" || len(value.StringListValue) != 0 || value.IntegerValue < 1 || value.IntegerValue > TeacherOnboardingSemanticWeeklyMinutesMaximum {
				return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeSemanticQuestions(values []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion) error {
	seen := make(map[TeacherOnboardingSlotCode]struct{}, len(values))
	for index := range values {
		values[index].Question = strings.TrimSpace(values[index].Question)
		if !validTeacherOnboardingSlot(values[index].Slot) || !validSemanticText(values[index].Question, TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestionMaximumRunes) {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		if _, exists := seen[values[index].Slot]; exists {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		seen[values[index].Slot] = struct{}{}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeSemanticUncertainties(values []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty) error {
	seen := make(map[TeacherOnboardingSlotCode]struct{}, len(values))
	for index := range values {
		values[index].Reason = strings.TrimSpace(values[index].Reason)
		values[index].Detail = strings.TrimSpace(values[index].Detail)
		if !validTeacherOnboardingSlot(values[index].Slot) ||
			(values[index].Reason != "ambiguous" && values[index].Reason != "conflicting" && values[index].Reason != "insufficient" && values[index].Reason != "unsupported_value") ||
			!validSemanticText(values[index].Detail, TeacherOnboardingSemanticDetailMaximumRunes) {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		if _, exists := seen[values[index].Slot]; exists {
			return ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
		seen[values[index].Slot] = struct{}{}
	}
	return nil
}

func validSemanticText(value string, maximum int) bool {
	return utf8.ValidString(value) && strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" && utf8.RuneCountInString(value) <= maximum
}

func validSemanticTextOrEmpty(value string, maximum int) bool {
	return utf8.ValidString(value) && utf8.RuneCountInString(value) <= maximum
}

func teacherOnboardingSlotOrder() []TeacherOnboardingSlotCode {
	return []TeacherOnboardingSlotCode{
		TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, TeacherOnboardingSlotKnownStacks,
		TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks, TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode, TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalText,
		TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage, TeacherOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes, TeacherOnboardingSlotPace,
	}
}

func semanticSlotIndex(slot TeacherOnboardingSlotCode) int {
	for index, candidate := range teacherOnboardingSlotOrder() {
		if candidate == slot {
			return index
		}
	}
	return len(teacherOnboardingSlotOrder())
}
